outcome: Risk factors for combined twin deliveries
Rate of fetal/neonatal death or serious neonatal morbidity
cohort: 842 women with twin gestation between 32+0 and 38+6 weeks gestation, with the first twin in vertex presentation at randomization, who had a vaginal delivery of twin A
finding: The only risk factor significantly associated with a combined delivery was transverse/oblique lie of twin B following delivery of twin A.
mod_finding: Combined delivery (vaginal delivery of twin A followed by cesarean delivery of twin B) is associated with a higher risk of adverse neonatal outcomes for twin B.
